etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Inherited from Middle English lauden, from Old French lauder, borrowed from Latin laudō, laudāre, from laus (“praise, glory, fame, renown”), from Proto-Indo-European *leh₁wdʰ- (“song, sound”). Cognate with Old English lēoþ (“song, poem”), German Lied (“song”). Doublet of leed.
